work.title: The Tragedy of Hamlet, Prince of Denmark
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 3, Scene 3
scene.title: SCENE III. A room in the Castle.

lines.text: I like him not, nor stands it safe with us
lines.plainText: I like him not nor stands it safe with us

lines.text: To let his madness range. Therefore prepare you,
lines.plainText: To let his madness range Therefore prepare you

lines.text: I your commission will forthwith dispatch,
lines.plainText: I your commission will forthwith dispatch

lines.text: And he to England shall along with you.
lines.plainText: And he to England shall along with you

lines.text: The terms of our estate may not endure
lines.plainText: The terms of our estate may not endure

lines.text: Hazard so near us as doth hourly grow
lines.plainText: Hazard so near us as doth hourly grow

lines.text: Out of his lunacies.
lines.plainText: Out of his lunacies

lines.text: We will ourselves provide.
lines.plainText: We will ourselves provide

lines.text: Most holy and religious fear it is
lines.plainText: Most holy and religious fear it is

lines.text: To keep those many many bodies safe
lines.plainText: To keep those many many bodies safe

lines.text: That live and feed upon your Majesty.
lines.plainText: That live and feed upon your Majesty

lines.text: The single and peculiar life is bound
lines.plainText: The single and peculiar life is bound

lines.text: With all the strength and armour of the mind,
lines.plainText: With all the strength and armour of the mind

lines.text: To keep itself from 'noyance; but much more
lines.plainText: To keep itself from 'noyance but much more

lines.text: That spirit upon whose weal depend and rest
lines.plainText: That spirit upon whose weal depend and rest

lines.text: The lives of many. The cease of majesty
lines.plainText: The lives of many The cease of majesty

lines.text: Dies not alone; but like a gulf doth draw
lines.plainText: Dies not alone but like a gulf doth draw

lines.text: What's near it with it. It is a massy wheel
lines.plainText: What's near it with it It is a massy wheel

lines.text: Fix'd on the summit of the highest mount,
lines.plainText: Fix'd on the summit of the highest mount

lines.text: To whose huge spokes ten thousand lesser things
lines.plainText: To whose huge spokes ten thousand lesser things

lines.text: Are mortis'd and adjoin'd; which when it falls,
lines.plainText: Are mortis'd and adjoin'd which when it falls

lines.text: Each small annexment, petty consequence,
lines.plainText: Each small annexment petty consequence

lines.text: Attends the boist'rous ruin. Never alone
lines.plainText: Attends the boist'rous ruin Never alone

lines.text: Did the King sigh, but with a general groan.
lines.plainText: Did the King sigh but with a general groan

lines.text: Arm you, I pray you, to this speedy voyage;
lines.plainText: Arm you I pray you to this speedy voyage

lines.text: For we will fetters put upon this fear,
lines.plainText: For we will fetters put upon this fear

lines.text: Which now goes too free-footed.
lines.plainText: Which now goes too freefooted

lines.text: My lord, he's going to his mother's closet.
lines.plainText: My lord he's going to his mother's closet

lines.text: Behind the arras I'll convey myself
lines.plainText: Behind the arras I'll convey myself

lines.text: To hear the process. I'll warrant she'll tax him home,
lines.plainText: To hear the process I'll warrant she'll tax him home

lines.text: And as you said, and wisely was it said,
lines.plainText: And as you said and wisely was it said

lines.text: 'Tis meet that some more audience than a mother,
lines.plainText: 'Tis meet that some more audience than a mother

lines.text: Since nature makes them partial, should o'erhear
lines.plainText: Since nature makes them partial should o'erhear

lines.text: The speech of vantage. Fare you well, my liege,
lines.plainText: The speech of vantage Fare you well my liege

lines.text: I'll call upon you ere you go to bed,
lines.plainText: I'll call upon you ere you go to bed

lines.text: And tell you what I know.
lines.plainText: And tell you what I know

lines.text: Thanks, dear my lord.
lines.plainText: Thanks dear my lord

lines.text: Now might I do it pat, now he is praying.
lines.plainText: Now might I do it pat now he is praying

lines.text: And now I'll do't. And so he goes to heaven;
lines.plainText: And now I'll do't And so he goes to heaven

lines.text: And so am I reveng'd. That would be scann'd:
lines.plainText: And so am I reveng'd That would be scann'd

lines.text: A villain kills my father, and for that
lines.plainText: A villain kills my father and for that

lines.text: I, his sole son, do this same villain send
lines.plainText: I his sole son do this same villain send

lines.text: To heaven. O, this is hire and salary, not revenge.
lines.plainText: To heaven O this is hire and salary not revenge

lines.text: He took my father grossly, full of bread,
lines.plainText: He took my father grossly full of bread

lines.text: With all his crimes broad blown, as flush as May;
lines.plainText: With all his crimes broad blown as flush as May

lines.text: And how his audit stands, who knows save heaven?
lines.plainText: And how his audit stands who knows save heaven

lines.text: But in our circumstance and course of thought,
lines.plainText: But in our circumstance and course of thought

lines.text: 'Tis heavy with him. And am I then reveng'd,
lines.plainText: 'Tis heavy with him And am I then reveng'd

lines.text: To take him in the purging of his soul,
lines.plainText: To take him in the purging of his soul

lines.text: When he is fit and season'd for his passage? No.
lines.plainText: When he is fit and season'd for his passage No

lines.text: Up, sword, and know thou a more horrid hent:
lines.plainText: Up sword and know thou a more horrid hent

lines.text: When he is drunk asleep; or in his rage,
lines.plainText: When he is drunk asleep or in his rage

lines.text: Or in th'incestuous pleasure of his bed,
lines.plainText: Or in th'incestuous pleasure of his bed

lines.text: At gaming, swearing; or about some act
lines.plainText: At gaming swearing or about some act

lines.text: That has no relish of salvation in't,
lines.plainText: That has no relish of salvation in't

lines.text: Then trip him, that his heels may kick at heaven,
lines.plainText: Then trip him that his heels may kick at heaven

lines.text: And that his soul may be as damn'd and black
lines.plainText: And that his soul may be as damn'd and black

lines.text: As hell, whereto it goes. My mother stays.
lines.plainText: As hell whereto it goes My mother stays

lines.text: This physic but prolongs thy sickly days.
lines.plainText: This physic but prolongs thy sickly days

lines.text: My words fly up, my thoughts remain below.
lines.plainText: My words fly up my thoughts remain below

lines.text: Words without thoughts never to heaven go.
lines.plainText: Words without thoughts never to heaven go
